table.retrieve:
SELECT invcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode, 
		 customer = Max(dbo.accounts.name),
		 date = CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
							When 'originaldate' Then Max(dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate) 
							When 'lastsavingdate' Then Max(dbo.saleledgermodified.date)
							When 'billingdate' Then Max(dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate)
				  End ,
		 regno = Max(dbo.patient.regno),
		 patient = Max(dbo.patient.name),
		 rank = Max(dbo.rank.name),
		 unit = Max(dbo.unit.name),
       relation = Max(dbo.relation.name) ,
       disease = Max(dbo.disease.name) ,
		 doctor = Max(dbo.doctors.name),
		 itemname = Max(item.name),
		 packing  = Max(item.packingdesc),
		 price    = Max(dbo.saledetailmodified.saleprice),
		 looseqty = Sum(dbo.saledetailmodified.looseqty)
		  
FROM 	 
	dbo.saleledgermodified
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Doctors ON (dbo.saleledgermodified.doctcode = dbo.doctors.doctcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Relation ON  (dbo.saleledgermodified.relationcode = dbo.relation.relationcode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Disease ON (dbo.saleledgermodified.diseasecode = dbo.disease.diseasecode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Ward ON (dbo.saleledgermodified.wardcode = dbo.ward.wardcode),
	dbo.saledetailmodified,    
	dbo.item, 
	dbo.Customer,
	dbo.Patient,
	dbo.Rank,
	dbo.Unit,
	dbo.Accounts

WHERE  CASE lower(:as_datetype) 
				When 'originaldate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.originaldate 
				When 'lastsavingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.date
				When 'billingdate' Then dbo.saleledgermodified.billingdate
		 End Between :ad_startdate And :ad_enddate    AND
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode  IN ( :al_custcode ) AND
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) AND
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode AND
		 dbo.saledetailmodified.icode = item.icode AND
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode AND
		 dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode AND
		 dbo.patient.rankcode = dbo.rank.rankcode AND
		 dbo.patient.unitcode = dbo.unit.unitcode AND
		 dbo.saleledgermodified.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode

Group By dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,
		   dbo.saledetailmodified.icode,
			dbo.saledetailmodified.rowgroup
